change: Coalesce adjacent equality values with the same action only when every rule for a syscall tests equality on the same argument. Keep holes and action changes, use checked 64-bit adjacency, and emit each range through the existing condition compiler. Lazily index duplicate conditions after 64 retained rules while preserving rule order, unconditional precedence and conflict detection.

compiler_performance.scope: One optimized ARM64 executable, 9 workloads, 5 warmup pairs then 30 measured pairs per workload, alternating the original and new compiler. Includes JSON parsing; black-boxes inputs and confirms every compilation returns the same initial result. Local compiler timings, not whole-engine Docker or Podman speed.
compiler_performance.confidence_interval: Paired median baseline/candidate latency ratio; 10000 bootstrap resamples, seed 803270. Ratios are omitted when the baseline rejects the profile.
compiler_performance.summary: For 800 dense equalities, the ARM64 filter shrinks from 4008 to 13 instructions and median compile latency falls from 1.731 ms to 1.511 ms. Default and other small-workload intervals include parity; no universal speedup is claimed.
